data.title: Speeding fine notice, €98.50 and 1 point
data.summary: The Central Fines Office (Zentrale Bußgeldstelle Musterland) issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) dated 16 September 2025 for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 27 August 2025. The total is €98.50, plus 1 point in the driving aptitude register.
data.explanation: You are accused of speeding by 23 km/h outside built-up areas (93 km/h in a 70 km/h zone). The notice was formally delivered on 19 September 2025. You may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the fines office. The app shows the deadline, which is two weeks after delivery. If you don't object in time, the notice becomes final and can be enforced. Then the total of €98.50 is due within two weeks of it becoming final. If you are unsure whether to object, consider getting legal advice.
